children: Italy's Moncler could have been hit by difficult market conditions in a number of markets during the third quarter, analysts at Jefferies write in a research note. The maker of high-end puffer jackets might have experienced challenges, including lower travel spend from Asian customers in Europe, the analysts say. Moreover, the reduced boost to wealth in the U.S. and Korea is impacting luxury demand, while the warm weather in Europe could have delayed seasonal purchases, such as Moncler's outerwear, they say. Meanwhile, the analysts expect the company to have outperformed in China, despite weak trends there for other luxury players. Share fall 0.6%. (andrea.figueras@wsj.com)
